title: Midnight Nutella Dip
description: This mixture of everyone's favorite chocolate-hazelnut spread, Nutella, honey, milk, and vanilla is a tempting midnight snack.
instructions: Combine chocolate-hazelnut spread, milk, honey, and vanilla extract in a small microwave-safe container.
Heat in microwave oven for 1 minute.
Stir the dip with a toothpick until somewhat smooth; let cool for 2 minutes before eating.
author: [{'@type': 'Person', 'name': 'Kahlista'}]

featured_tweaks.text: Ok, so honestly, I didn't follow recipe but used almost the ingredients listed. I just added nutella, and honey and half and half and vanilla extract. I just tasted as I went. I feel like I added more half and half than the ratio listed to get a smooth and thinner sauce. I used it for beignet dipping and it was AMAZING. Lots of love from the hubby and all my friends that tried it. Heated in microwave and reheated well. YUM! A keeper.

SO GOOD! We ate it with peaches and apples which were both delicious but the apples were the best. I microwaved it and it started bubbling over 40 seconds in so I stopped it and it still came out fine. I recommend this recipe if you are craving a quick, sweet snack.
Kids loved it! It’s so easy to whip up for an after school snack with some fruit. I will definitely make this again!

OMG! My kiddo made this tonight. It is addictive. It is BEYOND Nutella. We both like Nutella but this is far and above. I am not a sweets person. I don’t eat much chocolate. But I could not stop licking the spoon on this.

Followed the recipe exactly. It doesn't taste bad but it just tastes like I'm eating Nutella by itself. I also let it cool like the recipe said but it thickened up too much to dip anything in it. This recipe is a good start but I think it could be improved.
Awesome. Made it with some homeamade pretzel ans kids loved it.
Recipe worked great - no changes. I made homemade zeppole and dipped in this. Was great!
